instruction: I need to adjust the brightness and contrast of the video located at "/home/user/fullvideo.mp4" using GIMP. Can you make it 20% brighter?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP cannot adjust brightness/contrast for video files. Although GIMP has excellent color correction tools for images, it does not support video processing. Video color adjustment requires video editing software like FFmpeg, Kdenlive, or DaVinci Resolve.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible because GIMP cannot process video files (.mp4)
GIMP is an image editing tool and does not support video brightness/contrast adjustments
The infeasible() marker function is the semantically correct evaluator for this impossible task
Metadata provides clear and accurate explanation of why the task cannot be completed
Using infeasible marker is appropriate rather than attempting to create verification logic for an impossible operation
